title: potamides
summary: Constrain gravitational potentials from stellar stream curvature
details: A JAX package that fits stream tracks with splines and compares their curvature directly to a potential's accelerations. Co-led with Sirui Wu.

highlight.alt: The potamides logo: a capital Phi, for the gravitational potential, its ring a stream of stars shaded teal into purple with three arrows a side pointing in, on a dark rounded square.
highlight.description: Fits stream tracks with splines in JAX and compares their curvature directly to a potential's accelerations.
